item.title: Industrial Chemical Handling Solutions for Diverse Sectors
item.description:
Reliable Chemical Handling Across Industries
#

Our product range is engineered to meet the demanding requirements of chemical handling in a wide variety of industrial sectors. We offer several pump series tailored for general industrial use, capable of managing common acids, alkalis, and a broad spectrum of organic and inorganic chemicals.

item.title: Innovative Solutions for Chemical Pumping and Environmental Engineering
item.description:
Advanced Chemical Pumping and Environmental Solutions
#

ASSOMA specializes in the design and manufacture of high-performance chemical pumps and related systems, serving a wide range of industries with a focus on safety, efficiency, and environmental responsibility.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Chemical Handling and Pumping Applications
item.description:
Engineered Chemical Pumping Solutions for Industry Needs
#

ASSOMA specializes in the design and manufacture of sealless centrifugal magnetic drive pumps, chemical filters, and system accessories tailored for the safe handling of aggressive and hazardous chemicals. Our expertise enables us to deliver custom solutions that address the specific requirements of various industries, including electronics, chemical processing, environmental engineering, and energy sectors.
